verdict.statement: The candidate closes substantial Rust process, CBOR, framing, frame-shape, terminal, cancellation, candidate-atomicity and no-retransmission detail, but the exact bytes do not compose into one implementation. The limits handshake is internally inconsistent; ToolPathV1 is not representable in the pinned C-2 parameter carrier; the listed state machine cannot reach Complete without invented alias semantics; prepared repository outputs have no byte-bearing transport; the D9 Unavailable row conflicts with requiredness-sensitive frozen D9 behavior; subject and requested-Coverage-domain construction remains host-private; and the supervisor event rows are not mutually exclusive. These are exact interoperability/application blockers, not product-evidence residuals.

blockingFindings.finding: Hello requires ProtocolLimitsV1 exact equality with the artifact limits object. ProtocolLimitsV1 is closed and requires exactly the 21 numeric fields, while the artifact limits object has those 21 fields plus the string field limitRule. A wire value cannot be both the closed 21-field record and exact structural equality with the 22-field object.
blockingFindings.checkerEscape: The authored checker silently projects EXPECTED_LIMITS to the 21 numeric fields in its Hello fixture, so its positive fixture chooses one side of the contradiction rather than falsifying the exact prose equality.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Define one closed numeric ProtocolLimitsV1 projection explicitly and say Hello equals that projection, or move limitRule outside the object before requiring whole-object equality. Add a negative control for the extra/missing limitRule fork and define the exact byte measure for maxCandidateSpoolBytes.

blockingFindings.finding: The narrow join says ToolPathV1 is nested under C-2 capabilityGrants[].parameters so it enters PLAN-ID-V1 tag 10. The pinned C-2 boundedParameterValue rule requires every map key to be a lowercase canonicalIdentifier matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[._:-][a-z0-9]+)*$. Three required ToolPathV1 keys are camelCase and fail that rule.
blockingFindings.checkerEscape: The authored checker validates the ToolPathV1 local field set and searches for the phrase field 10, but does not recursively apply the pinned C-2 boundedParameterValue map-key grammar to the nested ToolPathV1 record.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Use C-2-valid lowercase canonical keys in the Plan-bound parameter representation and bind their exact wire projection, or obtain and pin an accepted C-2 successor that explicitly admits the chosen keys. Add a recursive carrier conformance probe.

blockingFindings.finding: Under exact state-name equality, Analyze reaches ANALYZING_FIRST_STAGE_NO_OUTPUT. FactBatch and Coverage are sourced from ANALYZING_STAGE, BudgetExhausted from ANALYZING_ANY_STAGE, and Complete from READY_COMPLETE. The artifact defines no state taxonomy, wildcard expansion, alias relation, transition from ANALYZING_FIRST_STAGE_NO_OUTPUT to ANALYZING_STAGE, or resolution of NEXT_STAGE_OR_READY_COMPLETE. Therefore the exact 17-row transition list cannot traverse a normal analysis to Complete without an implementation inventing semantics.
blockingFindings.checkerEscape: The authored checker checks transition count and selected prose tokens, then executes a separate simplified phase machine which does not interpret the artifact transition list. Its one-stage happy path therefore cannot prove the listed automaton is closed.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Replace pseudo-state names with a concrete parametric transition algorithm over stageIndex, batchIndex, candidateOrdinal and outputSeen, or define an exact state-subtyping/wildcard expansion and every NEXT_STAGE_OR_READY_COMPLETE branch. Retain multi-stage, zero-batch, cancel-at-every-phase and post-terminal falsifiers.

blockingFindings.finding: The selected host-preparation design says the semantic child consumes sealed build-script/procedural-macro outputs, executes no project code, reads only the sealed VFS, receives no live root and has no durable-state authority. RepositoryResolutionV1 carries buildScriptOutputs/procMacroOutputs rows, but the pinned rust-v1 rows contain cfg plus outputDigest or crateId plus outputDigest only. No frame, byte string, content-addressed blob reference with a read authority, or exact insertion into the pre-preparation Snapshot VFS carries the prepared output bytes. Two implementations must invent an inaccessible-CAS lookup, a private VFS augmentation, or an unavailable fallback.
blockingFindings.checkerEscape: The authored fixture compares metadata rows and digests only; it never demonstrates a byte-bearing prepared output reaching the sidecar.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Bind a closed, ordered, bounded prepared-output corpus with exact bytes or authenticated content-addressed references and a child read boundary; commit it into PlanId and define its wire/VFS projection. Otherwise remove prepared-mode semantic consumption and make the affected domains explicitly unavailable.

blockingFindings.finding: The verified-unavailable row unconditionally projects deficiency=provider-unavailable and reasonCode=COVERAGE.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. Frozen D9 v1.13 has two different valid outcomes: analysis-optional-provider-unavailable has deficiency=none and success, while analysis-required-provider-unavailable has provider-unavailable, indeterminate and the reason code. The supervisor event alone lacks requiredness/finalization axes and cannot select one exact D9 termination.
blockingFindings.checkerEscape: The authored checker verifies that the vocabulary tokens occur in the row and that the 15-row list hash is fixed; it does not derive requiredness-sensitive D9 axes for the row.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Make Unavailable a Coverage observation first, then bind exact host-finalizer requiredness input and conditional D9 projections. Apply the same contextual rule to BudgetExhausted where optional evidence may not determine command termination.

blockingFindings.finding: The pinned C-2 fact-derivation stage has exactly kind, stageId, optional dependsOn/budget, relations, operator and optional capabilityGrants/providerId. The Rust wire adds subjects and requestedCoverageDomain. Their local shapes and subject-scope commitment are defined, but no pinned owner or deterministic construction derives subject IDs/ranges/order, relation rung selection, source/target universe combinations or the complete requested key set from C-2, Plan, RI and Snapshot. Coverage is a bijection only to a host-private domain, so two hosts can emit different valid requests for the same frozen inputs.
blockingFindings.checkerEscape: The authored checker constructs one private fixture subject and one Coverage key. It validates equality against that fixture but does not derive either array from the pinned C-2/RI/Snapshot inputs.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Add an accepted owner and exact algorithm or Plan-bound closed values for the complete Rust subject domain and Coverage request domain, including subjectId/range/order and relation-resolution/universe enumeration. Then test two independent derivations for byte equality.

blockingFindings.finding: The join claims every child outcome is classified by exactly one row after interruption precedence, but the event predicates are not disjoint and no provider-fault precedence reducer is defined. A malformed frame followed by nonzero exit matches two rows; a post-terminal byte followed by nonzero exit matches two rows; and a Coverage violation followed by hang/kill matches two rows. Equal final public error codes do not make the asserted exact-one-row classification true.
blockingFindings.checkerEscape: The authored checker checks 15 unique event names and a semantic hash. It does not apply the prose predicates to composite observations or prove pairwise disjointness/exhaustiveness.
blockingFindings.requiredRepair: Define an ordered normalization reducer for simultaneous provider observations, or replace overlapping rows with disjoint predicates and prove one-and-only-one coverage across composite fault sets after user-interruption precedence.

auditSection5ForkReview.evidence: The key is exactly (ExecutionId, SnapshotId, complete recursively validated rust-v1 value), workersPerDistinctKey=1, and digest-only substitution is forbidden. A fresh recursive-key model distinguished execution, snapshot and universe changes and retained one child for same-key stage sharing.
The join separately forbids cross-universe, cross-ExecutionId, cross-SnapshotId, cross-attempt, resident and post-terminal reuse; same-key Rust stages share one Analyze only.

Start is after AttemptRecord, Snapshot, PlanId, repository projection and admitted stages, immediately before the first Rust stage. Every fate closes pipes, kills if live, reaps owned descendants, deletes scratch and forgets state. Product/platform behavior remains unexecuted.

An independent RFC 8949 restricted encoder/decoder round-tripped 17 values and rejected 13 noncanonical/forbidden families: negative, non-shortest, float, tag, indefinite, duplicate key, non-text key, wrong key order, invalid UTF-8, non-NFC, truncation, trailing bytes and undefined/simple. It imported no checker code.

Independent framing reproduced uint64 big-endian payload length, 32 raw SHA-256 payload digest and exact payload. Six negative probes rejected prefix truncation, payload truncation, trailing byte, digest mismatch, length mismatch and oversize-before-allocation.

Twenty-one numeric frame/aggregate/snapshot/stage/relation/subject/Coverage/candidate/spool/stderr/scratch/grace bounds are declared and checked-sum prose exists, but the wire/artifact equality is internally inconsistent. The successor must also define the exact byte-accounting unit for candidate spool.

The seven host request frame names and their closed payload field sets are present, and snapshot chunk/seal shapes are explicit. End-to-end C-2/RI/VFS projection is not closed for prepared output content or the two host-added semantic-domain arrays.

All ten worker response frames have exact directions, payload type bindings and closed required field sets. FactCandidateV1 uses the pinned 14-field FACT-PLANE candidate transport and FACT-ID remains host-owned. This shape result does not cure request-domain or state-machine blockers.
The 17 named transition rows cannot traverse their exact state names from Analyze to FactBatch/Coverage/Complete.

Independent directional sequences begin at zero and increment exactly; batchIndex, candidateOrdinal and Coverage entry order are stated contiguous; retransmission/replay/overflow is faulted. The ordering rules remain unusable until the concrete analysis states are repaired.

Complete is the sole success terminal. Every worker terminal is candidate-only until zero exit within grace and EOF with no extra byte; nonzero, signal, timeout, early EOF and post-terminal bytes fault, subject to user-signal precedence.

Cancel is one user-interrupt host terminal from a nonterminal state; only Cancelled may follow; request write closes; 5000 ms grace, kill/reap and interrupted/130 precedence are bound. No runtime implementation evidence is claimed.

The host owns candidate-only spool; ten admission preconditions defer atomic candidates/Coverage until Complete, validation, commitments, zero exit and EOF; nine grouped non-success/fault families discard candidates. Fresh fate probes admitted only valid Complete and discarded four valid non-success plus six invalid/cancel cases. Exact spool byte accounting must be repaired with finding 01.

Relative to an already supplied domain, three independent stage bijections passed and nine missing/duplicate/unrequested/order/ordinal/union mutations rejected. The complete domain itself is not independently derivable from frozen inputs.

The six RI equality fields plus the exact six-field signed Rust capability row, capabilityManifestId Plan commitment and pre-source disclosure equality are closed. The required limits member has no satisfiable exact representation.

The command array, absolute provider path, verified toolchain/scratch roots, protocol-only pipes, exact LANG/LC_ALL/TZ environment, no parent/PATH/project credentials, five supported platform precheck and pinned component containment are explicit. Physical qualification is correctly residual.

Host pre-Plan ownership, network=false and no sidecar project execution avoid the PlanId future-result cycle in intent, and absolute roots are excluded from PlanId. The chosen logical ToolPath record is invalid in its carrier and the prepared output corpus cannot reach the child.

All named clean, delivery, protocol, crash, EOF, timeout, post-terminal and cancellation fates are present and timeout is not BudgetExhausted. Composite observations are not classified by exactly one row.

Direct D9 reconstruction produced ten operational-failed/exit-4 fault rows, two interrupted/130 rows and three context-dependent clean rows. The candidate hard-codes one contextual row and lacks a disjoint event reducer. D9 v1.13 and this join remain conditional/not applied.

Protocol v1 explicitly has no retransmission, acknowledgement retry or deduplication. Duplicate/replayed directional sequence is provider-protocol; no generic Phase 3 retransmission claim is imported.
